## Projects

- tamil-tokenizer: BPE tokenizer for Tamil written in Rust. It runs 11-16x faster than SentencePiece, has a 32K vocab on Hugging Face, and 23 tests. https://github.com/barryallen16/tamil-tokenizer
- VulnChecker-Java: LoRA fine-tune of Qwen2.5-Coder for Java vulnerability detection. The 7B model scored 80.39% on a 102-case eval, above the 14B base. https://github.com/barryallen16/VulnChecker-Java
- sivabharani-comments: pipeline over 2,755 Tamil videos. It ran 1,185,665 transcript chunks through local Gemma 4-bit inference and published the dataset on Hugging Face. https://github.com/barryallen16/sivabharani-comments
- kaggle-automation: FastAPI control plane that pools Kaggle accounts, shards GPU jobs across them, and watches 12-hour sessions with Telegram alerts. https://github.com/barryallen16/kaggle-automation
- fitcheck-website: outfit recommender that runs FashionCLIP fully in the browser and builds looks from the user's own wardrobe. https://github.com/barryallen16/fitcheck-website
- ats-resume-creation-skill: agent skill that writes ATS-friendly resumes as docx and PDF, with an application tracker. The resume on this site came out of it. https://github.com/barryallen16/ats-resume-creation-skill
- moviemod-scraper: distributed Selenium scraper with domain rotation, multiprocess workers, MySQL dedup, and Telegram alerts. https://github.com/barryallen16/moviemod-scraper
- Memory: bookmarklet that fuzzy-matches Google Forms fields and autofills them. https://barryallen16.github.io/Memory/
- unshortenBuddy: Telegram bot that resolves ad-walled short links with headless Chrome and caches results in Postgres. https://github.com/barryallen16/unshortenBuddy

## Projects in brief

Each project below is described by the problem it solves, the tradeoff made, and how it was built.

- tamil-tokenizer — Problem: general-purpose subword vocabularies shatter Tamil into too many pieces, so Tamil corpora cost more tokens and train slower than English ones. Tradeoff: hand-writing BPE in Rust instead of building on SentencePiece or Hugging Face tokenizers. Solution: 247 Tamil character clusters as base tokens, Aho-Corasick encoding, rayon-parallel BPE training. 11-16x faster than SentencePiece, 32K vocab, 23 tests.
- VulnChecker-Java — Problem: static analyzers miss SQL injection, XSS, and insecure deserialization in Java. Tradeoff: budget on dedup rather than parameters; the 7B beat the 14B (80.39% vs 78.43% on 102 cases). Solution: seven pipeline stages to conversation-formatted SFT, SHA-256 dedup, LoRA fine-tune, fixed 102-case eval harness.
- sivabharani-comments — Problem: a Tamil YouTuber answers subscriber questions across 2,000+ videos and nobody could find the one answering theirs. Tradeoff: an LLM pass over all 1.18M transcript chunks instead of plain search. Solution: 2,755 videos scraped, chunks filtered through local Gemma 4-bit to keep name mentions. Dataset on Hugging Face.
- kaggle-automation — Problem: Kaggle sessions expire after 12 hours, killing long training runs. Tradeoff: sharding one job across several accounts, at the cost of coordination and retry handling. Solution: FastAPI control plane, session monitoring, Telegram alerts.
- fitcheck-website — Problem: full wardrobes, no outfit ideas. Tradeoff: running FashionCLIP in the browser instead of on a server. Solution: client-side FashionCLIP builds combinations from a photographed wardrobe.
- ats-resume-creation-skill — Problem: rewriting the same resume per job and hand-building docx/pdf output. Tradeoff: generation over hand-editing, at the cost of a consistent voice across applications. Solution: agent skill reads a job description, writes tailored content, exports docx and pdf, tracks applications.
- moviemod-scraper — Problem: a site that rotates domains and expires download links within hours. Tradeoff: Selenium plus a MySQL mirror over plain HTTP. Solution: live-domain resolution, multiprocess workers, MySQL dedup, Telegram alerts.
- Memory — Problem: filling the same Google Forms repeatedly by hand. Tradeoff: a bookmarklet over a browser extension, which breaks when Google changes form internals. Solution: fuzzy label matching plus writes through React's value setter.
- unshortenBuddy — Problem: short links hide destinations behind ad walls and timers. Tradeoff: headless Chrome per link instead of a plain HTTP request. Solution: Telegram bot walks the redirect chain, caches results in Postgres, admin-gated access.
